name: 3 · Midnight Cemetery
rule_text: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential.

levels.title: 3-01 · Graveyard Orientation
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. The cemetery quiet hours have been postponed indefinitely. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 3-02 · Moonlight on Credit
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. Necromancy is not covered by the employee handbook. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-03 · Lantern Tax
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The ghost requested a window seat in a building without windows. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-04 · HR Necromancy
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: The doctor recommends more brains. Seek a second opinion. The disco has a strict bring-your-own-pulse policy. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 3-05 · Dreamwalk This Way
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Your delivery is three lanes away and marked delivered. The grave digger has started charging by the encore. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 3-06 · No Mower After Midnight
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. No mowers. Any breach fails the mission. Also lose no more than 8 plants.
levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. The grave digger has started charging by the encore. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-07 · Root of All Evil
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. Necromancy is not covered by the employee handbook. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-08 · Disco in the Wrong Grave
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The ghost requested a window seat in a building without windows. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-09 · The Midnight Reserve
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Hold 4000 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. The disco has a strict bring-your-own-pulse policy. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-10 · Twenty Tombstone Planters
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Win with at most 20 planting actions, including grafts and rafts.
levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. The cemetery quiet hours have been postponed indefinitely. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-11 · Interns from Accounting
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Clear the fast waves within 330 seconds.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. The cemetery quiet hours have been postponed indefinitely. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 3-12 · Five Eulogies Maximum
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Lose no more than 5 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. The disco has a strict bring-your-own-pulse policy. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-13 · Graves Need Permits
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. Necromancy is not covered by the employee handbook. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-14 · Mandatory Disco
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. Necromancy is not covered by the employee handbook. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-15 · Graftyard Shift
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. The grave digger has started charging by the encore.

levels.title: 3-16 · Ghostbuster Without Plants
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. The cemetery quiet hours have been postponed indefinitely.

levels.title: 3-17 · Funeral Arrangement
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The ghost requested a window seat in a building without windows.

levels.title: 3-18 · Resurrection Paperwork
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The ghost requested a window seat in a building without windows. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-19 · Power Cut Picnic
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The ghost requested a window seat in a building without windows.

levels.title: 3-20 · Seeds for the Sleepless
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Fixed five-seed deck (graft two Pod Shooters into a Twin Pod for double fire) and a total limit of 24 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. The grave digger has started charging by the encore.

levels.title: 3-21 · Protect the Night Watch
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. No planting. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. The cemetery quiet hours have been postponed indefinitely.

levels.title: 3-22 · Forty-Five Hundred Moons
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Collect a total of 4500 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. Necromancy is not covered by the employee handbook. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-23 · Bucket Beyond the Grave
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. The disco has a strict bring-your-own-pulse policy. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-24 · Last Dance at Dawn
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Long mixed assault. Pace your economy: the waves never stop being polite about it.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. The disco has a strict bring-your-own-pulse policy. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 3-25 · Granite Grave Mistake
levels.briefing: No natural sky sun. Moonlight pulses give 50 sun; producers are essential. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. The grave digger has started charging by the encore. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.
